metadata.note: P1-01 custom bleed contract (FIX-R1): a user-written contract, NOT a Golden replay. The contract itself is healthy (variant_by_accept); the bleed is produced by running it against a force_uri_only proxy, i.e. `accepttwin run --contract tests/fixtures/contracts/custom-bleed.json --proxy-mode force_uri_only`, which must yield REPRESENTATION_BLEED with first_error 6. Own loopback ports (18773 proxy / 18774 origin). See docs/USAGE.md.

name: Custom bleed site (synthetic origin + URI-only cache proxy)
